description: Rules that apply to every device in your organisation; devices pick up a change at their next check-in.
title: Organisation settings
sectionPolicyDesc: The organisation's devices only talk to each other. Rules decide traffic; what no rule covers follows the setting below.
policyOpen: Allowed: devices can reach each other
policyDeny: Blocked: only what a rule allows gets through
fieldStaleness: How long the device list stays valid when the network does not respond (seconds)
fieldStalenessHint: If a device cannot reach the network, it keeps using the last list for this long. After that it disconnects from all other devices.
stalenessInvalid: Enter a number of seconds, at least 60.
saved: Settings saved. They reach devices at the next check.
forbidden: Only the organisation's owner or an administrator can change these settings.
profileRegulatedDesc: Emergency erasure, hidden groups and three-stop routes are off and cannot be turned on. Only the platform administrator can change this level.
profileStandardDesc: Each feature is switched on or off separately, below.
transportBody: Data travels inside an encrypted WireGuard tunnel. Each device pair's key changes every two minutes. This is classic encryption, not quantum-resistant. Traffic disguising is not active, and OpenVPN and VLESS are not available.
loadError: Could not load the settings. Try again.
failed: The settings were not saved. Try again.

gateway.title: Gateways for phones and computers
gateway.body: Devices added with the WireGuard app connect through one of these devices. New devices use the default. To move a device, open it in Devices.
gateway.none: No gateway yet. Phones and computers cannot be added until you add one.
gateway.caption: Gateways
gateway.noCandidate: Every enrolled device is already a gateway. Enroll another device to add one.
gateway.endpointInvalid: Write an address and a port, like gw.example.org:51820.
gateway.removeBody: The device stays on the network. It stops accepting phones and computers that use the WireGuard app.
gateway.servesDevices_one: {{name}} still serves 1 device. Move it to another gateway from Devices, then remove it.
gateway.servesDevices_other: {{name}} still serves {{count}} devices. Move them to another gateway from Devices, then remove it.
gateway.isDefault: New devices join through {{name}}. Make another gateway the default first, then remove it.
gateway.failed: The change was not saved. Try again.
gateway.loadFailed: The gateways could not be loaded.
gateway.onlyAdmin: Only a platform administrator or an administrator can manage gateways.
